entry.title: dotnet/roslyn - Issues & Pull Requests - 2025-11-26
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • Roslyn should move back to calling IVsRunningDocumentTable.Advise on the UI thread #81459
  • Unexpected behavior for ternary operators with implicit casting of null #81458
  • Compilation of this example with VS in .net8 hanging #81456
  • Incorrect auto-indentation after pressing Enter in a lambda #81455

Closed

  • Nested 'for' semantic snippet fails to simplify global::System.Int32 to int #71542
    18.3
  • Inaccessible generic type name in "nameof" is reported as a method group #20444
  • Visual Studio 2022 incorrectly formats code with parameterized types #81460
  • After installing VS2026 all Builds fail with CSC : error CS2016: Code page '1252' is invalid or not installed #81381
    18.3
  • Visual Studio 2022 C#, 'forr' code snippet creates strange looking code #78368
    Backlog
  • For loops autofill is different when inside a loop #74839
    18.3
  • Code snippet 'forr' creates strange looking code when the new loop is nested within another loop #81457
  • Formatting operations fail to account for adaptive formatting #69995
    Backlog
  • Compiler Crash with extension blocks #81443
  • Code style options severity not respected during build using non-en windows #81417
  • [Automated] PRs inserted in VS build main-11225.29 #81449

PullRequests

Created

  • Simplify option passing to formatter/simplifier #81462
    Area-IDE, VSCode
  • Simplify parsing of variable declarators. #81454
    Area-Compilers, VSCode
  • Mark ERR_FunctionPointerTypesInAttributeNotSupported as build-only #81453
    Area-Compilers, VSCode
  • Adjust behavior of is-type operator for `Union` types #81448
    Area-Compilers, Feature - Unions

Merged

  • Map edits in LSP rename, like in VS #81450
    Area-IDE, VSCode, Next
  • Remove more unused bits of Razor EA #81452
    Area-IDE, Next
  • Fix for-snippet not simplifying #81461
    Area-IDE, VSCode, Next
  • Register encoding provider when `GetEncoding` throws `NotSupportedException` #81382
    Area-Compilers, Next
  • Parse analysis level with invariant culture #81438
    Area-IDE, VSCode, Next

Updated

  • Further clean up Roslyn's package load #80598
    Area-IDE
  • Unsafe evolution: handle the rest of pointer-related operations #81420
    Area-Compilers, Feature - Unsafe Evolution
  • Fix CS1003 error message when expression follows identifier without '=' #81285
    Area-Compilers, VSCode
  • Add IOp support for `with(...)` elements. #81427
    Area-Compilers, Needs API Review, Feature - Collection Arguments
  • Emit async-iterators with runtime-async when possible #81314
    Area-Compilers, Feature - Runtime Async
  • Replace copied System.IO.Hashing files with official NuGet package #81061
    VSCode
  • Improve location of error diagnostic when encountering errant operator token #81295
    Area-Compilers
  • Avoid `virtual` implementations for `AddSynthesizedAttributes` #81289
    Area-Compilers
  • [main] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #81409
    Area-Compilers, VSCode
  • Improve error message for misplaced variable designator in property patterns #81287
    Area-Compilers
  • Implement exhaustiveness check for Union types #81442
    Area-Compilers, Feature - Closed Class Hierarchies, Feature - Unions
